messages:
Maria: heads-up: Polaris AI case study draft is ready. want a quick review and to lock a publish + webinar CTA. target publish Fri 9am PT.

Ashley: I can do edits. did product sign off on metrics? need final numbers for latency and cost.

Jordan: Product confirmed steady-state cost down 34% and p95 latency improved from 280ms -> 95ms. source metric sheet: <https://docs.redwood/internal/polaris-metrics>.

Priya: good to know. do we have a customer-approved quote? Polaris legal still reviewing.

Maria: Customer interview was last week, transcript in the folder. Ashley, draft hero quote + 2 social lines by EOD.

Ashley: Draft hero: "With Redwood we shrank inference tail times and scaled without blowing our infra budget." will tighten once I have final numbers.

Jordan: prefer numeric callout in hero. suggest: "Redwood cut our p95 latency by ~3x and reduced serving costs by 34%."

Priya: Legal: Polaris requires a signoff flow. Please submit quote via our portal. SalesOpsBot: ping when submission received.

SalesOpsBot: submission link: <https://legal.redwood/submit?case=polaris-1768>. Reminder: vendor/customer approvals take 24-72h during embargo windows.

Maria: Noted. Can we still schedule draft post to auto-publish pending approval? want to avoid manual at 9am.

Jordan: yes — we can set draft in CMS with publish lock. Need approved image assets (2 social cards) and webinar registration link.

Ashley: assets in drive: <https://drive.redwood/content/polaris-assets>. I'll attach variants for X and LinkedIn.

Priya: Legal: submitted quote approved with two edits: replace "we" with company name and remove reference to competitor by implication. uploaded redline: <https://legal.redwood/approvals/polaris-1768/redline.pdf>.

Maria: thanks. Ashley update hero quote and social lines, then we'll load into CMS. Also include webinar CTA: "Join our Mar 28 webinar for performance deep-dive" with reg link.

Ashley: updated hero: "Polaris AI reduced p95 latency ~3x and lowered serving costs by 34% with Redwood." social line options uploaded.

Jordan: SalesOps: routing plan? we want MQL -> AE queue, mark leads as 'polaris_case' and tag webinar registrants separately.

SalesOpsBot: created HubSpot workflow: Lead source=polaris_case, UTM tags applied, AE queue webhook set to #sales-notify. Test event posted.

Maria: set embargo until publish. Priya confirm legal artifacts archived and consent recorded.

Priya: consent recorded in vendor folder and signed CAA attached. closed legal loop.

Ashley: queued draft in CMS for Fri 9am PT; pending publish lock removal after legal confirmation. assets and meta uploaded.

Jordan: quick checklist before publish: 1) CMS draft 2) legal approval 3) HubSpot workflow live 4) webinar reg link live 5) social cards uploaded. All green except final legal flag (just cleared).

SalesOpsBot: smoke test passed: webhook delivered to AE queue and sample lead created with UTM params.

Maria: great — flip to publish. Ashley, hit publish. I'll post a short announce note in #general after it goes live.

Ashley: published at 09:00 PT. link: <https://redwood.com/blog/polaris-ai-inference-case>. social posts queued.

Jordan: confirmed inbound webhook fired and first demo request created. routing working.

Priya: legal files saved to project folder. attaching final approval doc.

Maria: excellent work team. I'll close thread after announce post. :celebrate:
